text:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident triggered -> INC-2026-1174
Service: inference-runtime-prod (expected) 
Routing service: infra-oncall (actual) 
Severity: P1
Triggered by: /metrics/error_rate > 5% for 2m
Link: https://app.pagerduty.com/incidents/INC-2026-1174

alex r: Wait, why did infra-oncall get this? That should go to runtime-oncall.

jen t: I saw a ton of infra pages this morning, is this the same schedule binding bug? :eyes:

maria g: Confirming — the PD service id attached to the alert is wrong. Looks like the alert rule points to service id svc_89b but our runtime service is svc_92f. Could be a manual change.

ops-bot: Output from pdctl bindings --service svc_89b 
```
Service: infra-oncall (svc_89b)
Bindings:
 - schedule: infra-schedule (active)
 - escalation policy: infra-ep
Last modified by: ops-playbook (2026-03-14T08:12:03Z)
```

oncall-bot: runtime-oncall current responder: kyle p (primary), siva n (secondary)

alex r: kyle — can you ack if this is your incident? The PD link says infra got it so it might be missed.

kyle p: Acking now. I didn't get the original PD page (it landed on infra). I'm on it, will look into traffic spill.

siva n: FWIW I'm on partial leave, but available for pager if escalations happen.

jen t: Root cause hypothesis: alert rule migrated during yesterday's alert-cleanup job and the destination service id didn't update. We have a known migration script that sometimes leaves stale bindings.

maria g: Agreed. For now, manual reroute the incident to runtime-oncall and update the alert rule. Steps: 1) Reroute PD incident 2) Update alert target in alerts-api 3) Kick off playbook.

pagerduty-bot: Running reroute command -> pd incidents reroute INC-2026-1174 --to-service svc_92f

pagerduty-bot: Success. Incident INC-2026-1174 reassigned to runtime-oncall (svc_92f). Notifying runtime-oncall.

kyle p: Got it. Investigating logs. Initial signal shows increased 500s from our tokenization stage in eu-west-1, spike started ~08:04Z, correlated with a config rollout.

alex r: Any customer-facing impact? I see elevated error rates in the dashboard but not full outage.

maria g: Tentative: ~7% of requests for the EU cluster hit elevated 5xx for 08:04–08:09Z. We'll confirm.

ops-bot: Quick query: SELECT count(*) WHERE status>=500 AND region='eu-west-1' AND ts BETWEEN 1700000000 AND 1700000060;
```
Result: 12,340 errors (~6.8% of traffic for that minute)
```

kyle p: Rolling back the last config change to staging flag for tokenizer v2. Reverting in progress (scale task queued).

jen t: While kyle works rollback, I'll update the alert rule to reference svc_92f so future triggers go to the right oncall.

maria g: Note for postmortem: we need to reconcile the migration scripts and add a CI check that verifies alert -> service mapping.

pagerduty-bot: Incident acknowledged by kyle p at 2125000023. Escalation timer suspended.

kyle p: Rollback completed, tokenization service restarted across eu-west-1. Error rates dropping.

ops-bot: POST-deploy metrics: 500-rate down to 0.9% at 08:12Z.

alex r: Good. What about customers already exposed? Any SLO breaches?

maria g: Initial customer impact estimate: ~7% of requests impacted for ~5 minutes in eu-west-1, estimated affected customers: 3 paid accounts and some trial users. No data loss.

jen t: I filed a high-priority config PR referencing alert fix: https://git.internal/redwood/alerts/pull/412 — will merge after CI.

siva n: If PD routing fix is merged, can we add a redundant webhook to the runtime alert channel as a secondary path? Might reduce single-service misroute risk.

alex r: Good idea. Add to action items.

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-2026-1174 status: resolved by runtime-oncall (kyle p) at 2125000300. Notes: manual reroute, rollback of tokenizer flag, updates to alert binding.

maria g: Postmortem owners: jen t (alerts), kyle p (runtime), ops infra (migration scripts). I'll kick off a draft with timeline.

jen t: Quick action list in thread: 
- Merge alert fix PR (jen t)
- Add CI check for alert->service validation (ops infra)
- Add secondary webhook path (alex r)
- Run migration script in dry-run and reconcile mappings (maria g)

kyle p: Thanks everyone. No further mitigation required at this time.

alex r: :thumbsup: Closing thread once postmortem draft is up.
